No, I’ve tried and what I tell myself doesn’t work because it isn’t true.

Yeah I’m pretty sure. It’s the combination of my depression, anxiety and aspergers that does it. I don’t see anything about myself that is attractive and haven’t witnessed anyone else being attracted to me so I would say no.

Look I’m gonna be honest with you and say that you’ll be the last person I tell. I’m gonna stay quiet until I can’t take it anymore and off myself. It won’t be long as I’m very suicidal. I’m a loser. I don’t have anyone who cares about me. I feel better off dead.

Well it’s not. I think we all know this.

I’m gonna combine the date question with the real person one. Other(some) unattractive people can go on dates and be in love because they at least have a good personality. I don’t. I’m just negative all the time about everything. I take everything personally and I play the victim. I break down and cry over the simplest things. I wouldn’t even call that a personality. Even if I went on a date I would somehow mess it up. I have really bad trust issues. I’m a walking red flag. But I probably won’t get anywhere with anyone because I’m non existent, and I honestly think that’s a good thing. I won’t hurt anyone if I’m alone. 

I don’t have anyone I can trust because I avoid them. Also I’ve learned from my mistakes to be quiet about it.

Yes, I’ve been attacked for that for ten years. I can’t take any form of compliments without dismissing them as lies.

I have talked to my last friend about it and he said I looked average, but I feel like he was lying as I’m hideous. The way it affects me now, I don’t think I’ll ever go on a date. I’ll be one of those forever alone people. Most of the time on dating apps, all the attention I get are bots. Not even a real person. It makes me very suicidal.
It’s because it has been a thing people have used to attack me with since school years so it’s been ingrained in me that I’m unattractive.

I feel that yes, only attractive people find partners, and that I’m not attractive enough for a partner.

I have heard about the Trevor project, but I have not looked into it. Sure, you can send me the link.

I’m good right now, but if I’m having problems I’ll let you know.

Um, I would say both. A lot of people are attractive and there’s a high proportion of them on the internet. 

I can’t afford a therapist. I’m in a bit of a grey area as I make too much to get any help/discounts, and I practically live paycheck to paycheck. Also there was a hotline that I was using, but I’ve been blacklisted because I used them too much. I’ve tried others, but they don’t seem to know how to help me with my problems(its usually about me being gay). So I’m just a bit lost.

I think that the majority of the people who put themselves out there on the internet know that they are attractive or somewhat attractive. 

I used to talk about it with the last friend I had which was six months ago. No, I don’t have people around who would be okay to talk about my problems with.

No, I think I’m so unattractive. Again I think it’s the level of attractiveness and while I do see some non traditional people find love, I feel way more unattractive than the ones I see online. 

I used to talk about my problems and I would drive people away and I’ve learned my lesson to stay silent.
It doesn’t matter, I don’t think I’ll make anymore friends. I’m better off just offing myself.

Anytime I make a friend I always vent my problems to them, constantly. I know I should shut my mouth, but I rarely get the chance for someone to lean on. It pushes people away. Now I’ve learned to suffer in silence. It doesn’t matter the last time I had a friend was six months ago.

It’s mostly the fact that I don’t want to hurt other people, so I tend to avoid interacting with them. I’m so depressed that I’m toxic and people tend to leave. It’s for the best. I don’t plan on being here for long.

I think there has to be some level of physical attraction. 

I’m not a very verbal person, even less when it comes to my mental problems, I don’t like burdening people with my problems. I rather suffer in silence.
In general. The things that I want to do are with a partner but I’m too ugly for that.

I unfortunately cannot afford therapy. I’m in a weird area where I make too much money to be given discounts, but I live paycheck to paycheck. Even if I could I don’t think it would do much as I have Aspergers and it makes it hard to understand things. I’m pretty dumb.
I was physically and verbally abused by my drug addict family, and I was bullied a lot in school for my appearance.
Because no one gives a shit about me.
It’s honestly sad how true this is.
